item: SSLV launch-cost statement attributed to K. Sivan
location_in_source: paragraph 34; statement attributed to a 2019 ISRO annual press conference
notes: Supports an approximate Rs 30 crore statement; does not establish Rs 35 crore, a commercial tariff, or the 2026 USD conversion.
Includes development and qualification of vehicle systems and demonstration through SSLV-D1, D2 and D3; not a per-launch price.
Note says “Source: ISRO, Rs 30-35 crore (~$3.5-4M) per launch”; the traced report substantiates only approximately Rs 30 crore and supplies no FX date or method.
